sources.own_factual_extraction: The plan uses Attawapiskat River and Otoskwin River as separate names. Its protected corridor also contains lakes. It identifies Attawapiskat Lake beside Neskantaga, refers to the Attawapiskat River near Canada Lake, and discusses a possible eastward park extension to James Bay.
locators: PDF page 11 (zero-based), Regional Context; attempted visual acquisition did not yield an inspectable map

map_review.second_page_result: The tool returned an empty image reference without image data available for inspection; no map-based finding is claimed.

attempt_capture.hash_scope: UTF8 serialization of the web screenshot-tool return, consisting of an error and an empty image reference; not acquired map image bytes.

sources.extent_limit: Official usage and a protected corridor are supported. The plan does not establish that all selected headwaters, lake passages and the unprotected downstream continuation carry one name. No whole-route visual identity is established by this source.

sources.title: Pipestone River Provincial Park Management Plan
sources.agency: Ontario Ministry of Natural Resources / Ontario Parks
sources.publication_date_scope: Plan publication/approval year; downloaded PDF metadata indicates compilation in March 2010. The viewed zoning map is dated July 2002.
sources.publication_identity: Independent provincial protected-area plan. Its July 2002 Pipestone zoning map is distinct from the Otoskwin–Attawapiskat plan. The shared June 2001 regional-context map is not used as independent evidence.

local_text_extraction.hash_scope: Local pdftotext -layout output derived from the acquired PDF.

viewed_map_render.hash_scope: Local PNG render of PDF page32 (1-based), July2002 zoning map; not original publisher image bytes.

sources.own_factual_extraction: Section 8.1.2 distinguishes Otoskwin, Morris and Pipestone waterways. Section 6 separates the Morris and Williams drainage routes. The July 2002 zoning map labels Otoskwin, Bow and Badesdawa lakes and shows their corridor separately from the northern Pipestone corridor.
locators: PDF page32 (1-based), Pipestone River Provincial Park Natural Environment Zones, July2002

map_review.map_title: Pipestone River Provincial Park Natural Environment Zones

sources.extent_limit: The viewed map supplies upper-corridor context. It does not map the complete selected main-river path to James Bay, locate every selected source reach, or equate the park name with the name of all its waterways.
